platform.cook: Code-only rebuild/repackage with guarded --skip-cook; unchanged fingerprint-qualified prior full shader/material cook

ownership.terrain: VPP is sole generator/presenter; native layers, stamps, LOD, materials and collision
ownership.bodyIsolation: Existing VPP volume layer/stack; adapter now exposes TerrainLayer rather than hard-coding default
ownership.movement: UE character flying/falling/walking, native custom gravity and floor/base behavior; VPP character base mapping
ownership.specialization: Existing radial-centre/heading adapter; explicit host airborne source publication uses its existing update
ownership.selection: Fixture controller selects target at midpoint; no production gravity/body/demand manager

matrix.route: Native walk A, fly/8-frame fall/land B, walk B, fly/8-frame fall/land A, walk A

materialWitness.coordinatePath: Existing scale-lab world-minus-actor position; all native primitive custom values zero; zero quaternion rotation is equivalent to identity for the existing shader function
materialWitness.tileSource: Accepted native compiled surface library for each body
materialWitness.checks: Existing GPU texture/macro phase function on fixed body-local probes; native surface/material validity and foreign-geometry checks; actual visit screenshots
materialWitness.limits: Does not read raw pixel UVs or GPU velocity buffers, and does not certify temporal reconstruction or arbitrary materials

replay.controls: Add --control shared-layer or --control legacy-binding --fps 60 --offset origin; expect native passed=false with verified failure and cleanup

exclusions: production body-selection/physics lifecycle manager or streaming implementation
body rotation/motion/angular velocity or live UE origin shifts in this matrix
inverse-square/N-body gravity, blended gravity or inertial camera policy
world-forward/camera quaternion continuity across abrupt up change (heading uses minimal transport)
grounded or antipodal source changes, moving terrain-body physics
replication, multiple views, full-scene curvature or arbitrary spatial separation
real scientific datum/height provider, resources or measured DEM ingestion
GPU temporal/velocity/pixel-UV or arbitrary material certification
production frame time, lifecycle memory/leak or all prior matrix requalification
